about_the_game:
Unlimited food. No hunger. A perfect dream... until it turned into a nightmare.
The experiment has failed, and the world is now at risk of being consumed by the Overblooming.

Step into a ruined world where nature has overtaken what humanity left behind. Wander through abandoned villages, crumbling labs, and wild landscapes as you piece together the story of the people who once lived here. Notes and journals reveal not only what happened, but the hopes and fears of those caught in the disaster.

Your mission is urgent, but the path you take will be shaped by what you discover along the way.

Atmospheric exploration

Immerse yourself in a post-apocalyptic world where nature has reclaimed everything.

Story through discovery

Uncover the past through notes and journals scattered across the world.

Hand-crafted environments

From quiet villages to research facilities, each area tells its own story.

Immersive ambiance

Music and soundscapes that pull you deeper into the world.

A focused journey

A short but impactful narrative experience.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 11
  • Processor: Intel i7-12700H (20 core 2.3 GHz)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Laptop (6 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Tested on developer hardware only, lower-end systems may vary.

short_description: A failed experiment has unleashed the Overblooming, threatening to consume the world. Explore abandoned ruins overtaken by nature, uncover the fate of those who lived here, and push forward to stop the spreading disaster.
